---
title: "Model-iteration-3"
format: html
---

Model 3: new features, grouped CV, baselines, bootstrap CIs. Target = any wicket (`wickets`).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(yardstick)
library(here)
```

Read data and filter

```{r}
target_col <- "wickets"   

bbl_all <- readRDS(here("Pranav", "data", "bbl_t20_data.rds"))

bbl_all <- bbl_all |>
  filter(innings %in% c(1, 2), shortened_match == 0) |>
  mutate(
    phase_Powerplay = as.integer(phase == "Powerplay"),
    phase_Middle    = as.integer(phase == "Middle"),
    phase_Death     = as.integer(phase == "Death")
  )
```

Feature groups (kept separate so each group can be ablated)

```{r}
base_cols <- c(
  "innings", "over_no", "balls_remaining", "score_before",
  "wickets_lost_before", "required_runs", "free_hit",
  "bowler_balls_bowled_before", "bowler_economy_before",
  "bowler_boundary_p_before", "bowler_dot_ball_p_before",
  "batsman_runs_scored_before", "batsman_balls_faced_before",
  "batsman_strike_rate_before", "batsman_boundary_p_before",
  "career_matches_before", "career_batting_avg_before",
  "career_bowling_strike_rate_before", "career_batting_strike_rate_before",
  "career_boundary_p_before", "career_matches_bowled_before",
  "career_economy_before", "career_bowling_avg_before", "career_dot_p_before",
  "phase_Powerplay", "phase_Middle", "phase_Death"
)

ratio_cols <- c("current_rr", "required_rr", "rr_gap", "resources",
                "runs_per_wkt_in_hand", "batsman_sr_vs_rr", "batter_new")

momentum_cols <- c("ball_in_over", "balls_since_wicket", "balls_since_boundary",
                   "runs_last_6", "runs_last_12", "dots_last_6", "dots_last_12",
                   "wkts_last_12", "bnds_last_12")

partnership_cols <- c("partnership_runs_before", "partnership_balls_before")

feature_cols <- c(base_cols, ratio_cols, momentum_cols, partnership_cols)
```

Select and split (same 80/20 chronological split by match as Model 2)

```{r}
model_data <- bbl_all |>
  select(match_id, start_date, all_of(feature_cols), all_of(target_col))

match_dates <- model_data |>
  distinct(match_id, start_date) |>
  arrange(start_date, match_id)

cutoff_index <- floor(nrow(match_dates) * 0.8)
cutoff_date  <- match_dates$start_date[cutoff_index]

train_data <- model_data |> filter(start_date <= cutoff_date)
test_data  <- model_data |> filter(start_date >  cutoff_date)

y_train <- train_data[[target_col]]
y_test  <- test_data[[target_col]]

x_train <- train_data |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix()
x_test  <- test_data  |> select(all_of(feature_cols)) |> as.matrix()

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test,  label = y_test)

c(train_rows = nrow(train_data), test_rows = nrow(test_data),
  base_rate_train = mean(y_train), base_rate_test = mean(y_test))
```

Evaluation helper

```{r}
eval_preds <- function(truth, p) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-15), 1 - 1e-15)
  tibble(
    pr_auc  = pr_auc_vec(factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    roc_auc = roc_auc_vec(factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second"),
    logloss = -mean(truth * log(p) + (1 - truth) * log(1 - p)),
    brier   = mean((p - truth)^2)
  )
}
```

Baselines: constant base rate and simple logistic regression on basic match state

```{r}
base_pred <- rep(mean(y_train), length(y_test))

glm_fit <- glm(
  reformulate(c("innings", "over_no", "wickets_lost_before",
                "score_before", "free_hit"), response = target_col),
  data = train_data, family = binomial
)
glm_pred <- predict(glm_fit, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

baselines <- bind_rows(
  base_rate = eval_preds(y_test, base_pred),
  logistic  = eval_preds(y_test, glm_pred),
  .id = "model"
)
baselines
```

Grouped 5-fold CV: folds are built by match so no match is split across folds

```{r}

params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 5
)

set.seed(35571381)

train_matches <- unique(train_data$match_id)
fold_of_match <- sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(train_matches)))
folds <- lapply(1:5, function(k) {
  which(train_data$match_id %in% train_matches[fold_of_match == k])
})

t20_cv <- xgb.cv(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 1000,
  folds = folds,
  early_stopping_rounds = 25,
  print_every_n = 25,
  maximize = TRUE
)

best_nrounds <- t20_cv$evaluation_log$iter[
  which.max(t20_cv$evaluation_log$test_aucpr_mean)
]

best_nrounds
```

Final model and test evaluation

```{r}
t20_final <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  evals = list(train = dtrain),
  print_every_n = 50
)

pred_probs <- predict(t20_final, dtest)

results <- bind_rows(
  baselines,
  xgb_model3 = eval_preds(y_test, pred_probs) |> mutate(model = "xgb_model3")
)
results
```

Bootstrap CIs, resampling whole matches from the test set

```{r}
set.seed(35571381)

idx_by_match <- split(seq_len(nrow(test_data)), test_data$match_id)

boot <- map_dfr(1:200, function(i) {
  m   <- sample(names(idx_by_match), replace = TRUE)
  idx <- unlist(idx_by_match[m], use.names = FALSE)
  x <- eval_preds(y_test[idx], pred_probs[idx])
  b <- eval_preds(y_test[idx], glm_pred[idx])
  tibble(
    xgb_pr = x$pr_auc, xgb_roc = x$roc_auc,
    pr_gain_vs_logistic  = x$pr_auc  - b$pr_auc,
    roc_gain_vs_logistic = x$roc_auc - b$roc_auc
  )
})

boot |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric") |>
  group_by(metric) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value),
            lo = quantile(value, 0.025),
            hi = quantile(value, 0.975), .groups = "drop")
```

Calibration and feature importance

```{r}
calibration <- tibble(pred = pred_probs, actual = y_test) |>
  mutate(bucket = ntile(pred, 10)) |>
  group_by(bucket) |>
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred), mean_actual = mean(actual), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
calibration

importance <- xgb.importance(model = t20_final)
print(importance, n = 30)
```

Save

```{r}
saveRDS(
  list(model = t20_final, cv = t20_cv, params = params, feature_cols = feature_cols,
       results = results, boot = boot, calibration = calibration,
       importance = importance, pred_probs = pred_probs, y_test = y_test,
       test_data = test_data),
  here("Pranav", "data", "model_3_results.rds")
)
```
